facility.name: Aramis Hunter
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: Two of two children records reviewed did not have a health statement on file for review during the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The primary caregiver is providing transportation to children in care and did not notify licensing about the changes in her services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §747.301(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity: The duration of outside time was missing from the outdoor policy in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8)(A))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members Not Used in Child/Caregiver Ratio: Member of household not counted in ratio did not have orientation documented in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members Not Used in Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §747.905)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: Operational policies read did not address safe sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Operational policies read did not address promotion of physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit: The primary caregiver did not have documentation of the notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit (26 TAC §HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers: The operation does not have emergency phone numbers posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.401(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation: There is no documentation on file at the home to support that the caregiver assisting the primary caregiver has recieved orientation to the home. The person has been assiting the caregiver September 2017.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1303(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism: The caregiver is using a shelf accessible to children for diaper changing. There are no observed safety mechanisms in place such as raised sides.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism (26 TAC §747.3303(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information regarding how children will be evacuated and relocated during an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation (26 TAC §747.5003(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: There was Ajax observed in a bathroom cabinet that is accessible by children. Lysol and disinfectant wipes observed on a low shelf  accessible to children in the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three children's files did not contain complete emergency contact information. Two of the files were missing addresses and the one file did not include any emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: The caregiver is utilizing a low shelf accessible to children to change diapers. The shelf is located in the children's play area in which children have close contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: The air conditioning unit does not have a safeguard to prevent from children from sticking their hands or objects inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There is garbage and debris on the playground accessible to children. There is  a raid can, broken piece of wood and a glass jar laying in the yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §747.3203(8))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not mounted in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The operation does not have the most recent licensing report posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information regarding how children will be reunified with their parents after an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan (26 TAC §747.5003(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-List of Employees: The operation does not have a current list of employees posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-List of Employees (26 TAC §747.401(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information regarding how children will be cared for until they are released to their parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Training Hours: A caregiver assisting the primary caregiver did not have required training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation has been conducting emergency drills on days that the operation is closed and children are not in care. There were 6 months out of the year that the operation conducted sheltering, lockdown, and fire drills on Saturday's and Sunday's.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A fence is broken on the playground. The chain links are leaning and separate from the pole. There is a gap between the fence and home large enough for a child to escape through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-License: The operation does not have the permit posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-License (26 TAC §747.401(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The children were provided screen time during their nap and resting times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))
